meta.description: Platform operator's workbench: an agent explores the data in ClickHouse and assembles interactive investigation cards

login.intro: Platform operator's workbench. Sign in with a Google account — the agent and the data must not be accessible anonymously.
login.accessDenied: This account is not allowed to sign in. Ask to have your email added to AUTH_ALLOWED_EMAILS.

workbench.placeholder: Ask about the data in ClickHouse — the agent will find the right tables itself
workbench.emptyIntro: Ask a question about the data in ClickHouse — the agent will explore the schema, pick tables, write SQL and return interactive cards. Clicking points, rows and cells drills into the next layer.
